AberrantHypermorph.description:
Summons an <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Genestealers">Aberrant Hypermorph</style></style> in a free adjacent hex. The Aberrant Hypermorph can immediately attack, but cannot move this turn.

Aberrant Hypermorph's stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

AdaptiveStrategy.description: Triggers <link="tooltip:Keywords/RelentlessMarch"><style="KEY">Relentless March</style></link> again for all adjacent <style="NonCharacter">Non-Character</style> friendly units and makes them immediately take an action, dealing <style="Stat_Damage">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Damage</style> per <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style> if they attack.

AdrenalGlands.description: May move with <style="Stat_Movement">+{[extraMovement]} Movement</style> if that move ends in a hex adjacent to an enemy

AggressiveOnslaught.description:
When <style="Charging">charging</style>, <style="Faction_BloodAngels">Mataneo</style> summons {[nrOfSummons]} <style="Summon"><style="Faction_BloodAngels">Jump Pack Intercessors</style></style> adjacent to and immediately attacking his target. At the beginning of each of Mataneo's turns, if he is still on the battlefield, all Jump Pack Intercessors summoned this way leave the battlefield.

Jump Pack Intercessor stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

AllIsDust.description: Attacks against this unit with <style="Piercing_Ratio">{[pierceRatio]}% pierce ratio</style> or less are treated as having a <style="Piercing_Ratio">1% pierce ratio</style>.

AlphaWarrior.description:
If the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Winged Prime</style> has not moved this turn, summons a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Tyranids">Tyranid Warrior</style></style> on a free hex within <style="Synapse">Synapse</style> range. The <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Tyranids">Tyranid Warrior</style></style> cannot move this turn, but can immediately perform a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style> against an enemy in range.

Tyranid Warrior stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

AnvilShield.description: <style="Faction_SpaceWolves">Arjac</style> blocks an additional <style="Stat_Damage">{[blockDmg]} Damage</style> and when he <style="Stat_Block">Blocks</style> he covers the attacker's hex in <style="Effect_Ice">Ice</style>. If <style="Faction_SpaceWolves">Arjac</style> is below <style="Stat_Health">{[healthPct]}% Health</style>, or if his attacker is on a hex covered in <style="Effect_Ice">Ice</style>, he gains <style="Stat">+{[blockChance]}%</style> <style="Stat_Block">Block</style> <style="Stat_Chance">chance</style> and if he blocks a melee attack, the attacker is <style="Debuff_Stunned">Stunned</style> until the end of the attacker's next turn.

ArcScourge.description: Attacks an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes. Up to {[maxAdjacentTargets]} additional units adjacent to each other are also hit, including friendly units. Enemy units that are hit receive {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Molecular Damage and if they are Mechanical, they are also Stunned for 1 round. For each mechanical unit hit, Belisarius Cawl gains {[effectLevel]} level of Machine Vengeance. After using Arc Scourge, Belisarius Cawl can immediately use another action.

ArcaneShield.description:
After moving, <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Thaumachus</style> applies a <style="Buff_Shield">Shield</style> to the closest friendly unit within {[range]} hexes, preferring <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Thousand Sons</style> units, then other <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> units, then other friendly units, and lastly casting it on himself if there is no other valid target. The shield has <style="Stat_Health">{[shieldHp]} Health</style> and lasts one round.

If <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Thaumachus</style> does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of his turn.

ArchContaminator.description:
At the beginning of his turn all adjacent enemies take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Toxic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage</style> plus each <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style> also deals extra <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> equal to {[extraDmgPct]}-{[extraDmgPct_2]}% of the unit's max <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>. <style="Summon">Summons</style> take double damage.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

ArmoriumCherub.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage to a target within range {[range]}. Using Armorium Cherub does not end Vindicta's turn.

AstartesBanner.description: Other friendly units within {[range]} hexes score an additional <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style> with their melee attacks. This additional <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style> can deal a maximum of <style="Stat_Damage">{[maxDmg]} Damage</style>.

AttemptedPossession.description: Target an enemy within {[range]} hexes. The target and any <style="Summon">Summons</style> it has summoned become possessed and immediately perform a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style> against the closest enemy unit, preferring unpossessed targets. Possessed units deal <style="Stat">{[dmgPct]}%</style> of their own <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> to a maximum of <style="Stat_Damage">{[maxDmg]} Damage</style> per <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style>. Possessed <style="Summon">Summons</style> will move before attacking.

BarbedOvipositor.description:
When the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Parasite of Mortrex</style> defeats a unit it targeted that is not <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> it summons a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Tyranids">Ripper Swarm</style></style> in the defeated unit's hex. 

Ripper Swarm stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

BasiliskBarrage.description:
If <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Thaddeus Noble</style> has not moved, unleashes a barrage of {[nrOfProjectiles]} shells on any target on the battlefield, each dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style>. {[nrOfProjectiles_2]} randomly hit the target hex or surrounding hexes and the remaining 2 hit the hexes surrounding those. For each round that has ended, 1 more of the shells hits the target hex, starting with the shells hitting the outer hexes. The <style="Suppressive_Fire">Suppressive Fire</style> trait applies also to this ability.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

BattleFocus.description: After attacking or being attacked, moves <style="Stat_Movement">1</style> hex in a direction as far away from enemies as possible.

BeaconOfRage.description: For each time he was attacked in battle, up to a maximum of {[nrOfAttacks]} times, Azkor deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage. If Azkor has defeated an enemy in this battle, 50% of the extra damage granted by Beacon of Rage is added to the damage of melee attacks of adjacent friendly Chaos units.

BlackRage.description: If <style="Faction_BloodAngels">Lucien</style> has not moved, he is set to <style="Stat_Health">{[hpPct]}% Health</style>. He then immediately <style="Charging">charges</style> a targeted enemy in movement range and performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attack</style> against it. For this attack and until the end of the battle, Lucien has <style="Stat_Movement">+{[extraMovement]} Movement</style> and deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> when <style="Charging">charging</style>. Additionally, Lucien can no longer be controlled for the rest of the battle, and moves and attacks automatically at the beginning of his turn instead.

BlightGrenades.description:
Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Toxic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage</style> to an enemy unit within range {[range]} that is not on a hex with <style="Tile_Contamination">Contamination</style>, and up to two enemy units behind the target. This ability benefits from <style="Indirect_Fire">Indirect Fire</style>.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

BloodChalice.description: All adjacent friendly non-mechanical units are set to <style="Stat_Health">{[healthPct]}% Health</style>. Until the start of their next turn, affected units gain <style="Piercing_Ratio">+{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio</style> with melee attacks and <style="Healing">heal</style> for <style="Stat_Health">{[hpToHeal]} Health</style> if they perform a melee attack.

BloodyFury.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Chain">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Chain Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy. This attack scores <style="Stat_Hits">+{[extraHit]}</style> hit for each time <style="Faction_WorldEaters">Wrask</style> was attacked in this battle, to a maximum of <style="Stat_Hits">{[maxNrOfHits]}</style> hits total. Any leftover hits are allocated to remaining adjacent enemies, prioritising kills.

Boltstorm.description: <style="NormalAttack">Normal ranged attacks</style> deal an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Bolter">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage</style> to the target and to each enemy adjacent to the target that is also within range of <style="Faction_BlackTemplars">Brother Burchard</style>. Enemies hit are <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style> for 1 round.

Bounce.description: After being attacked, has a <style="STAT">{[chance]}%</style> chance to be <style="Displacement">thrown</style> to a new position within 2 hexes. If that hex is occupied, the <style="Faction_Orks">Large Squig</style> deals <style="DMG_Physical">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage</style> to the unit on that hex and <style="Displacement">pushes</style> it to a random free adjacent hex. This ability can also trigger if the <style="Faction_Orks">Large Squig</style> is killed by an attack, unless <style="Overkill">Overkilled</style>.

BrazierOfHolyFire.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Flame">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage</style> to a target enemy within range {[range]} and sets its hex on <style="Effect_Fire">Fire</style>. Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Flame">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage</style> vs <style="Daemon">Daemons</style> instead. ALL <style="Daemon">Daemons</style> within {[range_2]} hexes of the target take <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Extra Damage</style> this round and the next. <style="Immune">Immune</style> <style="Daemon">Daemons</style> only take <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct_2]}% Extra Damage</style>.

BringerOfDespair.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Power">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage</style> to a melee target and <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Power">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage</style> to another random enemy adjacent to <style="Faction_BlackLegion">Angrax</style>. Any resulting <style="Battle_Fatigue">Battle Fatigue</style> is triggered twice.

Burrowers.description: This unit may burrow in its turn, disappearing from the battlefield. In its following turn it must surface and may do so in any free hex. If adjacent to an enemy unit, it may attack in melee immediately.

CalibaniteGreatsword.description: Forcas can switch between two stances. Strike Stance: At the end of his turn, Forcas starts Overwatching, even if he attacked in his turn. When defeating a unit while Overwatching, he remains in Overwatch, retaining {[nrOfHits]} fewer hits compared to the previous attack. Sweep Stance: Forcas' normal attacks also deal {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to each enemy adjacent to both Forcas and the initial target. This ability can be used once per turn; each use switches the active Stance and does not end Forcas' turn. Only the first use of this ability in each battle counts as using an active ability.

CallInReinforcements.description:
At the end of the Vox-caster’s action, a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Cadian Guardsman</style></style> is summoned in a nearby free edge hex and immediately takes a turn. 

Cadian Guardsman’s stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

CallRipperSwarms.description:
Summons <style="Stat">{[nrOfSummons]}</style> burrowing <style="Summon">Ripper Swarms</style>, who emerge from the ground at the beginning of the Hive Tyrant's next turn, unless their hex is occupied by another unit

Ripper Swarms' stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

CamoCloak.description: Whenever an incoming <style="Stat_Range">ranged attack</style> has its number of hits reduced for any reason, it deals <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReduction]} Damage</style> per hit to this unit.

Catalyst.description: All friendly <style="Faction_Tyranids">Tyranid</style> units get <style="Stat_Armor">+{[extraArmor]} Armour</style> and a <style="Stat_Chance">{[blockChance]}% chance</style> to <style="Stat_Block">Block {[blockDmg]} Damage</style> for the rest of this turn and the coming enemy turn.

ChampionOfTheFeast.description: After moving, deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Power">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy and reduces this enemy's Armour by <style="Stat_Armor">{[armorReduction]} Armour</style> for the rest of the battle. If <style="Faction_BlackTemplars">Sword Brother Godswyl</style> does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of his turn.

Chronometron.description: All enemy units within range {[range]} are <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style> for {[nrOfRounds]} round. Affected <style="Summon">Summons</style> are <style="Debuff_Stunned">Stunned</style> instead. All enemies within range {[range]} take <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> from the next attack made by a unit against them, or <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg_2]} Damage</style> if the attacker is <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style>.

CloudOfFlies.description: Receives <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> while on a hex with <style="Tile_Contamination">Contamination</style>. If this unit is attacked while it is not on a hex with <style="Tile_Contamination">Contamination</style>, it has a {[chance]}% chance to contaminate the hex it is standing on.

CombatRestoratives.description: <style="Healing">Heals</style> himself and all adjacent friendly units for <style="Stat_Health">{[hpToHeal]} Health</style>. <style="Stat_Health">{[hpToHeal_2]} Health</style> if <style="Aliance_Imperial">Imperial</style>.

Conceal.description: <style="Faction_Aeldari">Aeldari</style> units within {[range]} hexes ignore their <style="Battle_Fatigue">Battle Fatigue</style> trait, if they have it, and are treated as having the <style="Camouflage">Camouflage</style> trait.

ControlEdict.description:
While Protector Imperative is active: After <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Tan Gi’da</style> attacks, summon a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Skitarii Vanguard</style></style> in a free adjacent hex. Cannot have more than <style="Stat">{[maxSummons]}</style> <style="Summon"><style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Skitarii Vanguards</style></style> summoned this way at the same time.

While Conqueror Imperative is active: After <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Tan Gi’da</style> attacks, all friendly adjacent <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> <style="Summon">Summons</style> also immediately attack his target if it is within range.

Skitarii Vanguard stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

CordClaw.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Direct">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy. All of <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Exitor-Rho</style>’s further attacks until the end of its next turn deal an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Direct">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Direct Damage</style>.

CosmicHorror.description: Whenever <style="Faction_Genestealers">the Patermine</style> defeats an enemy, it places a <style="Decoy">decoy</style> on the hex of that enemy. Other enemies surrounding the defeated unit have a <style="Stat_Chance">{[chance]}% chance</style> to be <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style> for 1 round, and have a <style="Stat_Chance">{[chance]}% chance</style> to trigger <style="Battle_Fatigue">Battle Fatigue</style> a second time, if they have it. When <style="Faction_Genestealers">the Patermine</style> moves onto a decoy, it <style="Healing">heals</style> itself for <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style>.

CrazedFocus.description: Deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> to enemies on hexes with a <style="HexEffect">hex effect</style>.

CrucibleOfBattle.description:
Deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> to enemies in surrounding hexes.
Deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg_2]} Damage</style> to <style="Big_Target">Big Targets</style>.
Deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg_3]} Damage</style> to enemies that are <style="Debuff_Stunned">Stunned</style> or on hexes with <style="Effect_Fire">Fire</style>.

CrusadeOfWrath.description: All other friendly units within {[range]} hexes gain <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> and <style="Piercing_Ratio">+{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio</style> in melee – regardless of Damage type – for this round and the next. <style="Faction_BlackTemplars">High Marshal Helbrecht</style> immediately performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attack</style> against a random adjacent enemy.

CrushingClaws.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy and <style="Debuff_Taunted">Taunts</style> them for 1 round. Enemies adjacent to both the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Tyrant Guard</style> and the target take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Physical">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Physical Damage</style> and then get <style="Displacement">pushed</style> back 1 hex. All affected units become <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style> for 1 round.

CultDemagogue.description:
Targets an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes and places <style="Decoy">decoys</style> on up to <style="Stat">{[nrOfSummons]}</style> random free hexes within {[range_2]} hexes around the target. Then summons <style="Summon2"><style="Faction_Genestealers">Neophyte Hybrids</style></style> on half of all the friendly <style="Decoy">decoys</style> in that area and all <style="Faction_Genestealers">Neophyte Hybrids</style> in that area immediately take a turn.

Neophyte Hybrid stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp_2]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg_2]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor_2]} Armour</style>

CursedOfTheWalkingPox.description: Each time this unit kills an enemy non-<style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> unit, a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_DeathGuard">Poxwalker</style></style> is summoned in that hex.

CursedPlagueBell.description: Friendly <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> units starting their turn within <style="Faction_DeathGuard">Corrodius'</style> <style="ContagionsOfNurgle">Contagion</style> aura gain <style="Stat_Movement">+{[extraMovement]} Movement</style> for this turn. Enemy <style="Psyker">Psyker</style> units within <style="Faction_DeathGuard">Corrodius'</style> <style="ContagionsOfNurgle">Contagion</style> aura deal <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[dmg]} Psychic Damage</style> to themselves each time one of their attacks deals <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style>.

CyclicIonBlaster.description:
All attacks deal an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Particle">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Particle Damage</style>.
If the target has a <style="Debuff_Markerlight">Markerlight</style> or the <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> trait these hits deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>.

DaRevolushun.description:
Whenever an adjacent unit is defeated, <style="Faction_Orks">Da Red Gobbo</style> summons a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Orks">Grot</style></style> in its hex, unless the defeated unit was a Grot. The summoned Grot can immediately attack an adjacent enemy. Whenever a friendly Grot is defeated anywhere on the battlefield, it explodes and deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to all adjacent Grots and all adjacent enemies.

Grot’s stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

DakkaDakkaDakka.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Projectile">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage</style> to an enemy within range {[range]}. Adds <style="Stat_Hits">+{[extraHits]}</style> hits for each time <style="Faction_Orks">Snappawrecka</style> was <style="Repairing">repaired</style> this battle, but cannot exceed <style="Stat_Hits">{[maxNrOfHits]} hits</style> in total. If the target is defeated, leftover hits are allocated to random enemies within {[range_2]} hexes. <style="Faction_Orks">Snappawrecka</style> also loses <style="Stat">{[healthPct]}%</style> of his maximum <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>.

DarkTalonStrike.description:
<style="Faction_DarkAngels">Azrael</style> calls in a Ravenwing Dark Talon to deal <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Direct">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage</style> to a target enemy within {[range]} hexes and <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Bolter">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Bolter Damage</style> to all enemies in an uninterrupted straight line originating from the initial target. All enemies hit are <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style>.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

DeathFromAbove.description: Summons 1 Inceptor for each round that has started. The Inceptors land adjacent to the target, whom they attack immediately. Note: if not enough hexes around the target are free, fewer Inceptors will be summoned. Inceptor stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour

Deathwing.description: Each time Baraqiel blocks damage during an attack, all further incoming damage is reduced by {[dmgReduction]} and the damage Baraqiel deals with melee or Plasma Cannon attacks is increased by {[extraDmg]} for 1 round. This effect is doubled against Chaos enemies or when standing adjacent to another friendly Dark Angel.

DeathwingKnight.description: Each time the <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Deathwing Knight</style> blocks damage during an attack, all further incoming damage is reduced by <style="Stat_Damage">{[dmgReduction]}</style> and the damage he deals is increased by <style="Stat_Damage">{[extraDmg]}</style> for 1 round. This effect is doubled against <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> enemies or when standing adjacent to another friendly <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Dark Angel</style>.

DecoysAndMisdirection.description: When an enemy moves onto a friendly <style="Decoy">decoy</style>, it takes <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style>. When a friendly unit resurrects onto or moves onto a friendly <style="Decoy">decoy</style>, it deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> until the end of its turn, and if it is a <style="Faction_Genestealers">Genestealer Cults</style> unit, it also places a new <style="Decoy">decoy</style> in a free adjacent hex.

DefendTheDivineWork.description: <style="Repairing">Repairs</style> himself and all friendly adjacent units <style="Stat_Health">{[hpToRepair]} Health</style>.

DefenderOfTheGreaterGood.description: Friendly units adjacent to <style="Faction_Tau">Shadowsun</style> or her <style="Faction_Tau">Command-Link Drone</style> deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> with ranged attacks, except attacks that deal <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic</style> Damage. Affected attacks also have a <style="Stat_Chance">chance</style> to score an additional <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style>. This chance is <style="Stat">{[chance]}%</style> for each round in which Shadowsun has been on the battlefield. Friendly <style="Faction_Tau">T'au Empire</style> units within 2 hexes of Shadowsun or her Command-Link Drone are also affected by this ability.

DestroyTheWitch.description: Gains <style="Stat_Movement">+{[extraMovement]} Movement</style> when there’s an enemy <style="Psyker">Psyker</style> on the battlefield. This unit and friendly adjacent units deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> with melee attacks against <style="Psyker">Psykers</style>.

DestroyerHive.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Direct">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage</style> to one random adjacent enemy at the start of his turn.

DevoutPush.description: Executes a <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attack</style> on a single target, then gets to move 1 additional hex.

DoctrinaImperatives.description: Tan Gi’da switches between two Imperatives that affect him and all friendly adjacent Mechanical units: Protector Imperative: Affected units have +{[extraArmor]} Armour. Conqueror Imperative: Affected units deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage against units with reduced Armour. This ability can be used once per turn instead of once per battle; each use switches the active Imperative. Tan Gi’da can attack after using this ability. Only the first use of this ability each battle counts as using an active ability.

Doom.description: All enemy units exactly {[range]} hexes away from <style="Faction_Aeldari">Eldryon</style> take <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> from other friendly unit's <style="NormalAttack">normal attacks</style>. Other friendly <style="Faction_Aeldari">Aeldari</style> units deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg_2]} Damage</style> with all their attacks to affected units instead.

Doombolt.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage, evenly distributing the hits between all enemies within {[range]} hexes. Adds +1 hit for each hex on the battlefield that is currently on Fire. Cannot exceed 9 hits. When Ahriman defeats an enemy with his normal ranged attack and Doombolt has already been used, then Doombolt can be used again in this battle.

Drachnyen.description: <style="Faction_BlackLegion">Abaddon</style> is set to <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style> and immediately performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attack</style> against an adjacent enemy unit. After this attack and for the rest of the battle, after performing a <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attack</style>, Abaddon performs a second attack against an adjacent enemy unit, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage</style>. Abaddon cannot be set to higher <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> than his maximum <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>.

DrawFire.description: Any friendly adjacent units hit by enemy attacks have half of the <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> (rounded down) hit the Terminator instead.

EarlyWarningOverride.description:
Summons 2 <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Tau">Shield Drones</style></style> into free adjacent hexes. Newly summoned <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Tau">Shield Drones</style></style> can immediately attack an enemy in <style="Stat_Melee">melee</style>, but cannot move this turn.
<style="Faction_Tau">Re'vas</style> also starts <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatching</style> until the start of her next turn, dealing <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>. When defeating a unit while <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatching</style>, she remains in <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatch</style>, retaining {[hitsReduction]} fewer <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> compared to the previous attack. 

Shield Drones' stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

EchoesFromTheWarp.description: When this unit moves, it leaves a time ghost behind on the hex it moved from. The time ghost vanishes if the hex becomes occupied by another unit or if the terrain becomes impassable (as with <style="Tile_Floe">Broken Ice</style>). The first time this unit dies each battle, if its time ghost is on the battlefield then it revives with <style="Stat_Health">Full Health</style> at its location. This works even if this unit is <style="Overkill">Overkilled</style>.

ElectroShock.description: When this unit performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attack</style>, it also deals {[dmgPct]}% of its <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> to a random enemy adjacent to the target and all damaged enemies are <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style> for 1 round.

EmbodiedProphecy.description: During its first {[nrOfRounds]} rounds, the <style="Faction_Sisterhood">Zephyrim</style> deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>, blocks an additional <style="Stat_Block">+{[blockDmg]} Damage</style> and their <style="Stat_Block">Block</style> <style="Stat_Chance">chance</style> is increased by <style="Stat">+{[blockChance]}%</style>.

EnmityForTheUnworthy.description: <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Forcas</style> deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style> for each adjacent unit and additionally <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> for each adjacent friendly <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Dark Angel</style>.

Executioner.description: An enemy target within range {[range]} takes <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> for each round that has started. If the target is eliminated, then an adjacent enemy unit also takes <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> for each round that has started.

ExemplarOfHate.description: Targets an enemy on the battlefield. For this round and the next, all friendly units deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> against that enemy with melee or <style="Overwatch">Overwatch</style> attacks. If that enemy is <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style>, it gets <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style> and <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Asmodai</style> or another friendly <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Dark Angel</style> immediately performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style> against the target, dealing <style="Stat">{[dmgPct]}%</style> of its own damage, to a maximum of <style="Stat_Damage">{[maxDmg]} Damage</style> per <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style>.

ExemplarOfTheKauyon.description:
<style="Faction_Tau">Commander Shadowsun</style> disappears, then reappears on a target hex adjacent to an allied unit and immediately performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style> against the closest enemy target. This attack deals an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[dmg]} Blast Damage</style>. A stationary <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Tau">Command-Link Drone</style></style> is summoned in the hex she previously occupied.

<style="Cooldown">Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round</style>.

Command-Link Drone stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

ExemplarOfTheMontka.description: Until the end of this turn, Commander Farsight and all other friendly Characters with a normal ranged attack gain Unstoppable and all their normal attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage. When attacking a Big Target, they deal +{[extraDmg_2]} Damage instead. Using Exemplar of the Mont'ka does not end Commander Farsight's turn.

ExplosiveMaladies.description: Friendly units adjacent to <style="Faction_DeathGuard">Pestillian</style> deal an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[extraDmg]} Blast Damage</style> with their <style="NormalAttack">normal ranged attacks</style>. Friendly <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> units adjacent to <style="Faction_DeathGuard">Pestillian</style> also deal this damage with <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attacks</style>. Enemies defeated by affected attacks are <style="Obliterated">always overkilled</style>.

ExplosivePresents.description:
Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to an enemy unit or friendly <style="Faction_Orks">Grot</style> within range {[range]} and all units adjacent to the target, except <style="Faction_Orks">Da Red Gobbo</style> itself. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a <style="Cooldown">cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} rounds</style>. This cooldown is reduced by {[cooldownReduction]} round whenever a Grot is defeated.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

FabricatorClawArray.description:
After moving, <style="Repairing">repairs</style> one random adjacent friendly <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> unit for <style="Stat_Health">{[hpToRepair]} Health</style>.
If <style="Faction_Necrons">Aleph-Null</style> does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of its turn.

Fealty.description: When <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Lion El'Jonson</style> performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attack</style>, he also deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style={[DamageProfileTypeStyle]}>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} {[DamageProfileType]}</style> to all enemies adjacent to both the target of the attack and to Lion El'Jonson.

FearOfTheUnseen.description:
Can only be used if the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Deathleaper</style> has not moved this turn. All enemies within {[range]} hexes get <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style> and trigger <style="Battle_Fatigue">Battle Fatigue</style>, if they have it. The <style="Faction_Tyranids">Deathleaper</style> vanishes and cannot be targeted or damaged for 1 round. In its next turn it can move to any free hex on the battlefield that is either within <style="Synapse">Synapse</style> range, has <style="Tile_Grass">Tall Grass</style> or is not adjacent to an enemy and its attacks deal an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Direct">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage</style>.

Initial <style="Cooldown">cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round</style>.

FearedInterrogator.description: Deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> against enemies that are <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style>, <style="Debuff_Stunned">Stunned</style>, or that are adjacent to another friendly <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Dark Angel</style>. Scores <style="Stat">{[extraHits]}</style> additional <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> if the enemy is also <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style>.

FeederTendrils.description: When <style="Charging">charging</style>, the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Deathleaper</style> deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>, <style="Healing">heals</style> for <style="Stat_Health">{[hpToHeal]} Health</style> and <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppresses</style> the target for 1 round.

FightingRetreat.description: Adjacent enemies gain a Markerlight. They also have {[hitsReduction]} fewer hits, to a minimum of one, and deal -{[dmgReduction]} Damage for one round. Until the end of this turn, Darkstrider and adjacent allied units with the Ranged Specialist trait gain the effect of the trait even if they started their turn adjacent to an enemy unit. Using Fighting Retreat does not end Darkstrider's turn if he is adjacent to an enemy, and he can move again if already moved in this turn.

FireAndReposition.description: May move as normal and attack. After attacking, she may make one more normal movement. In the following enemy turn, she takes <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReduction]} Damage</style> from ranged attacks. Can only be used if <style="Faction_Aeldari">Calandis</style> has a target in range.

FireOfAbsolution.description: When performing a ranged attack, also deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Flame">{[dmg]} Flame Damage</style> to all units adjacent to the target. Has a <style="Stat_Chance">{[chance]}% chance</style> of setting each adjacent hex on <style="Effect_Fire">Fire</style> as well.

FiringPosition.description: When defeating a unit with an attack triggered by <style="Overwatch">Overwatch</style>, the <style="Faction_BlackLegion">Havoc</style> stays in <style="Overwatch">Overwatch</style>, retaining {[hitsReduction]} fewer <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> compared to the previous attack.

FirstAmongTraitors.description: Other friendly <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> units within {[range]} hexes deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>. This value is increased by <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg_2]} Damage</style> for each attack <style="Faction_BlackLegion">Abaddon</style> has performed in this battle, up to a maximum of <style="Stat_Damage">+{[maxDmg]} Damage</style> after 13 attacks.

FlailSwing.description: Performs a melee attack dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to the target and triggering Haze of Corruption if the target is defeated. Any unit defeated by this attack or its add-on attacks from Haze of Corruption is always overkilled.

FleshmetalGuns.description:
At the start of his turn, <style="Faction_BlackLegion">Volk</style> gains one of three effects until the start of his next turn. The effects are granted one after the other, repeating every three turns.

Volk's ranged attacks score additional <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style>, based on the current effect:
<style="BUFF_no_underscore">Focused Malice</style>: <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Melta">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Melta Damage</style>
<style="BUFF_no_underscore">Ruinous Salvo</style>: <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Flame">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Flame Damage</style>
<style="BUFF_no_underscore">Warp Hail</style>: <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_3]}x</style> <style="DMG_Heavy">{[minDmg_3]}-{[maxDmg_3]} Heavy Round Damage</style>, and these hits add <style="Tile_DespoiledGround">Despoiled Ground</style> to the hexes of attacked units.

FloatingDeath.description:
Has +1 <style="Stat_Movement">Movement</style> when starting its turn within <style="Synapse">Synapse</style> range. This unit explodes when it attacks or if it or an adjacent friendly <style="Faction_Tyranids">Spore Mine</style> is defeated, and deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Toxic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage</style> to all adjacent enemies. Does not explode when <style="Overkill">overkilled</style>.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

Foehammer.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Power">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage</style> to an enemy within range {[range]} and the target is <style="Debuff_Stunned">Stunned</style> until the beginning of <style="Faction_SpaceWolves">Arjac</style>'s next turn. For each <style="Character">Character</style> that has been defeated in this battle, this ability deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>.

ForwardObservers.description: Targets an enemy unit within range {[range]} that does not have a <style="Debuff_Markerlight">Markerlight</style>. The target receives a <style="Debuff_Markerlight">Markerlight</style> for {[nrOfRounds]} rounds. The <style="Faction_Tau">Stealth Battlesuit</style> then receives <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgPctReduction]}% Damage</style> from ranged attacks for {[nrOfRounds_2]} round.

FoulInfusion.description: <style="Faction_DeathGuard">Pestillian</style> and all friendly <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> units within his <style="ContagionsOfNurgle">Contagion</style> aura deal an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Toxic">{[dmg]} Toxic Damage</style> with their <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attacks</style> for this round and the next. <style="Faction_DeathGuard">Pestillian</style> then immediately performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attack</style> against a random adjacent enemy.

FragBomb.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to an adjacent target and <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to ALL units adjacent to the target hex, except <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Kut Skoden</style> himself.

FragLance.description: When <style="Charging">charging</style>, <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attacks</style> deal an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style>.

Fragstorm.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to a target within {[range]} hexes and <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to up to {[nrOfTargets]} random hexes adjacent to the target, excluding hexes with friendly units on them.

FragstormGrenadeLauncher.description: Deals up to <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to a target within {[range]} hexes. Any leftover <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> are allocated to enemy units within {[range]} hexes, prioritising kills.

FrenziedFiring.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage to a target enemy in range {[range]} and to all enemies adjacent to it. Scores an additional hit to the target for each free hex adjacent to it, up to a maximum of {[maxNrOfHits]} hits. Additional hits from Fleshmetal Guns are scored against each enemy attacked.

FuelledByFury.description: Deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> with all attacks for each time a friendly <style="Character">Character</style> has used an active ability this battle. The first time each turn that <style="Faction_Ultramarines">Titus</style> is defeated he cannot be <style="Overkill">Overkilled</style>. The first time each turn he defeats an enemy with an attack triggered by <style="FinalJustice">Final Vengeance</style> he is immediately revived with a maximum of <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style>.

FullThrottle.description: Whenever this unit moves <style="Stat_Movement">{[movement]}</style> or more hexes, there’s a {[chance]}% chance its rokkit malfunctions and causes the <style="Faction_Orks">Storm Boy</style> to go up in flames. In this event the unit is not revivable.

FuryOfTheAncients.description: After moving, deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy and an additional enemy adjacent to the initial one. For 2 rounds, affected units cannot be revived, <style="Healing">healed</style>, <style="Repairing">repaired</style>, nor otherwise restore {[S/Health]}. If <style="Faction_BloodAngels">Mephiston</style> does not move, this ability triggers at the end of his turn.

GalvanicField.description: Whenever <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Actus</style> <style="Repairing">repairs</style> another unit, that unit immediately attacks a target in range, dealing <style="Stat">{[dmgPct]}%</style> of its own <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> to a maximum of <style="Stat_Damage">{[maxDmg]} Damage</style> per <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style>. <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Actus</style> can <style="Repairing">repair</style> other friendly units even if they are at full <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>.

GauntletsOfUltramar.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Bolter">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage</style> to all enemies within 2 hexes. Scores an additional <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style> against surrounding enemies.

GeminaeSuperia.description:
When attacked, summons a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Sisterhood">Geminae Superia</style></style> in a free adjacent hex, and immediately triggers its passive ability <link="tooltip:Keywords/Lifewards><style="KEY">Lifewards</style></link>. Can do this twice per battle.

Geminae Superia’s stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

GetEmRuntz.description:
Summons 1 <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Orks">Grot</style></style> in each adjacent hex that also has an enemy unit adjacent to it. Newly spawned <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Orks">Grots</style></style> can immediately attack an enemy in <style="Stat_Melee">melee</style>, but cannot move this turn. Enemy units attacked by a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Orks">Grot</style></style> this way are <style="Debuff_Taunted">Taunted</style> for 1 round.

Grot’s stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>

GrapnelLauncher.description: Targets an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes and deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Physical">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage</style> to it. If <style="Faction_SpaceWolves">Tjark</style> is not already adjacent to the target, it is then <style="Displacement">pulled</style> 1 hex towards <style="Faction_SpaceWolves">Tjark</style> if possible, and can be pulled over any elevation but not through impassable terrain. <style="Faction_SpaceWolves">Tjark</style> then moves to occupy the hex the target originally occupied if it's free, or a free adjacent hex if it is not. If there are no free hexes, then <style="Faction_SpaceWolves">Tjark</style> does not move.

GreatFrostAxe.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy and covers the hex the enemy stands on and all hexes adjacent to it in <style="Effect_Ice">Ice</style>. The <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crit Damage</style> bonus of the <style="Effect_Ice">Ice</style> is already applied for this attack.

GrimRetribution.description: During each enemy turn, if there is no enemy adjacent to <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Sarquael</style>, he shoots back at the first enemy within range that attacked him or a friendly adjacent <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Dark Angel</style>. This shot counts as <style="Overwatch">Overwatch</style> and deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Plasma">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage</style>.

GrotTank.description:
Calls in a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Orks">Grot Tank</style></style> in an adjacent free hex. The <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Orks">Grot Tank</style></style> cannot move in its first turn, but can immediately attack an enemy in range.

Grot Tank’s stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style> +<style="Stat_Health">{[extraHp]}</style> for each round that has started
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

GuardianOrganism.description: If the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Tyrant Guard</style> is within <style="Synapse">Synapse</style> range or did not move during its previous turn, it and friendly units affected by its <style="Big_Target">Big Target</style> trait take <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> during the enemy's next turn, up to a maximum of <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReduction]} Damage</style> per hit.

HailOfLivingAmmunition.description: This unit has <style="Stat_Hits">+{[extraHit]} hit</style> in ranged attacks for each Termagant it is adjacent to.

HammerOfWrath.description:
If <style="Faction_BloodAngels">Mataneo</style> has not moved, he gains <style="Buff_Infiltrate">Infiltrate</style> until the end of this turn, <style="Charging">charges</style> an enemy target that has a free adjacent hex within movement range {[range]}, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Power">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage</style> to the target and <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Physical">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Physical Damage</style> to all enemies adjacent to it. If Mataneo is at or below <style="Stat_Health">{[healthPct]}% Health</style>, doubles the damage dealt by this ability.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

HarbingerOfDestruction.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Direct">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage</style> to up to <style="STAT">{[nrOfUnits]}</style> enemies within {[range]} hexes.

HarlequinsPanoply.description: The first time each turn this unit blocks a hit, all further hits of the attack are discarded and the <style="Faction_Aeldari">Harlequin Player</style> moves 1 hex closer to the origin of the attack, if possible.

HarvesterOfSouls.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Heavy">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage</style> to a target within range {[range]} and to all enemies adjacent to the target that are also within range {[range]} of <style="Faction_Aeldari">Maugan Ra</style>. These attacks score an additional <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style> if Maugan Ra has not moved this turn.

HatefulAssault.description: Attacks any enemy that moves from a hex adjacent to him, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Power">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage</style>.

HaywireMine.description:
When moving, <style="Faction_AdeptusAstartes">Cyrus</style> places a <style="Steppable">Haywire Mine</style> on the hex he started his move on. Enemies moving onto a Haywire Mine take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style={[DamageProfileTypeStyle]}>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} {[DamageProfileType]}</style>. <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> enemies take an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style={[DamageProfileTypeStyle_2]}>{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} {[DamageProfileType_2]}</style>. If Cyrus does not move, he places a Haywire Mine in a free adjacent hex at the end of his turn.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

HazeOfCorruption.description: When <style="Faction_DeathGuard">{[UnitName]}</style> attacks and defeats a unit, any leftover <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> and an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Toxic">{[extraDmg]} Toxic Damage</style> is dealt to a random enemy adjacent to both {[UnitName]} and his initial target. If this unit is also defeated, this ability triggers again, dealing <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> to an additional unit adjacent to both {[UnitName]} and his initial target.

HeadClaimer.description:
For each enemy unit that <style="Faction_BlackLegion">Haarken</style> has defeated, his attacks deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> for the rest of the battle.
For each enemy <style="Character">Character</style> that he has defeated, his attacks also score <style="Stat_Hits">+{[extraHit]} hit</style> for the rest of the battle.

HealingBalms.description: When <style="Faction_SpaceWolves">Baldr</style> uses his action to <style="Healing">heal</style> a friendly unit, the healed unit has <style="Stat">+{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance</style> and deals <style="Stat_CritDamage">+{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage</style> for {[nrOfRounds]} rounds. At the start of its next turn, the affected unit is also healed for <style="Stat_Health">{[hpToHeal]} Health</style>. Baldr can heal friendly units even if they are at full <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>.

HeavyBoltPistol.description: Deals an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Bolter">{[dmg]} Bolter Damage</style> in melee.

HeavyGravCannon.description: Ranged attacks against <style="Mk_Gravis">MK X Gravis</style>, <style="Terminator_Armor">Terminator Armour</style> or <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> units deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> and have <style="Piercing_Ratio">+{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio</style>.

HeavyWarpFlamer.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style={[DamageProfileTypeStyle]}>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} {[DamageProfileType]}</style> to an enemy within range {[range]}. Adds <style="Stat_Hits">+1 hit</style> for each attack with <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style> that friendly units have performed this turn. Cannot exceed <style="Stat_Hits">{[maxNrOfHits]} hits</style>. If this attack defeats the target, any leftover hits are scored against enemies adjacent to the target and within range {[range]}, prioritising kills.

HellfireShells.description: Fires a burst of Hellfire shells at a target within {[range]} hexes. The shells deal {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage and +{[extraHit]}x hits against Big Targets. Rapid Fire does not apply to this ability.

HellfyreMissileRack.description:
Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Heavy">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage</style> to a target enemy unit within range {[range]} and an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Heavy">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage</style> to each enemy unit on the map that was dealt <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style> this turn, which can include the initial target again.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

HeraldOfTheApocalypse.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy and an additional enemy directly behind the target. Affected enemies receive <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> from the next attack made by a unit against them. Also triggers <style="Battle_Fatigue">Battle Fatigue</style> for all enemy units within {[range]} hexes of the original target.

HeroicFusillade.description: Targets an enemy unit that has a free surrounding hex within movement range {[range]} of Judh or is already on a hex surrounding Judh. She then moves to the free hex and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage to the target and all other enemies surrounding it. Crits deal an additional +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage for each free hex surrounding the targeted enemy. When Judh is resurrected and Heroic Fusillade has already been used, then it can be used again in this battle.

HolyDuel.description: <style="Faction_BlackTemplars">Brother Jaeger</style> <style="Debuff_Taunted">Taunts</style> an adjacent enemy unit and immediately performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style> against it. <style="Faction_BlackTemplars">Brother Jaeger</style> deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> and takes <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReduction]} Damage</style> from the target while it’s <style="Debuff_Taunted">Taunted</style> by him. <style="Faction_BlackTemplars">Brother Jaeger</style> is also <style="Debuff_Taunted">Taunted</style> by the target and the taunt does not expire with rounds passed.

HostOfPlagues.description: Whenever a non-<style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> enemy unit dies there is a <style="Stat_Chance">{[chance]}% chance</style> a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_DeathGuard">Poxwalker</style></style> is spawned on the hex where that unit died.

HungeringSwarm.description: Whenever this unit performs a melee attack, it deals <style="Stat_Hits">+{[extraHit]} hit</style> for each other friendly Hormagaunt or Ripper Swarm adjacent to the target.

HuntersBeyondDeath.description:
Deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> against <style="Psyker">Psykers</style>, and enemy <style="Psyker">Psykers</style> within 2 hexes deal <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReduction]} Damage</style>.

Unless they are <style="Immune">Immune</style>, Enemy <style="Psyker">Psykers</style> within 2 hexes will not hit an additional unit with their <style="NormalAttack">normal ranged attacks</style>.

HuntersInstincts.description: Gains <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> and takes <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReduction]} Damage</style> while on a hex with <style="Tile_Grass">Tall Grass</style>.

Hypermorph.description: Gains extra <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> equal to <style="STAT">{[healthPct]}%</style> of current <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>.

HypersensoryAbilities.description: The first time each enemy turn that <style="Faction_Genestealers">Judh</style> is attacked, she cannot fall below <style="Stat">{[hpPct]}%</style> of her current <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>. After the attack, she moves to a free adjacent hex and places a <style="Decoy">decoy</style> on the hex she moved from. Then, if she is within {[range]} hexes of the unit that attacked her, she deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Projectile">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage</style> to that unit.

IconOfObstinacy.description: <style="Faction_AdeptusAstartes">Lysander</style> and all friendly adjacent <style="Terminator_Armor">Terminator Armour</style> units deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>. When they end their turn without attacking, they also have <style="Stat_Armor">+{[extraArmor]} Armour</style> until the beginning of their next turn. The additional <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> and <style="Stat_Armor">Armour</style> are further increased by <style="STAT">{[chance]}%</style> of the affected unit's current <style="Stat_Damage">Block Damage</style> value.

IncendiaryShells.description: Fires the Astartes shotgun at an enemy within {[range]} hexes, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Flame">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage</style>.

Incursion.description:
Summons a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_BlackLegion">Bloodletter</style></style> adjacent to an enemy target within range {[range]}. The Bloodletter immediately attacks the target. Keeps summoning Bloodletters up to a max of {[maxSummons]}, as long as the target has not been defeated, is in range and has a free hex adjacent to it. 

Bloodletter’s stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>

InescapableAccuracy.description: If Maugan Ra has not moved, then his ranged attacks ignore hit reductions, have +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance, and deal an additional {[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage. Inescapable Accuracy applies to targets of Harvester of Souls as well as attacks triggered by Overwatch.

InescapableDeath.description: <style="Faction_Necrons">Imospekh</style> deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> while <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatching</style>. When Imospekh defeats a unit while <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatching</style>, they stay in <style="Overwatch">Overwatch</style>, retaining {[hitsReduction]} fewer <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> compared to the previous attack.

InfernalPacts.description: Friendly <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style> units adjacent to <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Abraxas</style> deal an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> with their <style="NormalAttack">normal ranged attacks</style>. Affected <style="Daemon">Daemons</style> also gain the bonus <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style> on their <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attack</style>.

InspiredToGreatness.description: Enables a friendly unit in an adjacent hex to use their active ability again in this battle and heals or repairs it for {[hpToHeal]} Health. For this second use, the ability is at the lowest of its own level and that of Inspired to Greatness. If that unit has not used their active ability yet, then {[hpToHeal_2]} Health is restored instead.

InstrumentsOfVengeance.description:
<style="Faction_DarkAngels">Lion El'Jonson</style> marks hexes in two straight lines, originating from the edges of the battlefield. At the end of this turn, if there is no enemy unit adjacent to Lion El'Jonson, he starts <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatching</style>. At the beginning of his next turn, all enemies on marked hexes take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style={[DamageProfileTypeStyle]}>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} {[DamageProfileType]}</style>. Lion El'Jonson then summons <style="STAT">{[nrOfSummons]}</style> <style="Summon"><style="Faction_DarkAngels">Deathwing Knights</style></style> in free hexes on the battlefield. They can immediately attack enemies in range, but cannot move this turn.

Deathwing Knight stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

InvocationOfMachineVengeance.description:
Summons <style="Stat">{[nrOfSummons]}</style> <style="Summon"><style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Tech-Priest Enginseers</style></style> at the bottom of the map. Then adds <style="Stat">{[effectLevel]}</style> level of <style="Buff_MachineVengeance">Machine Vengeance</style> to all friendly <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> units on the battlefield.

Tech-Priest Enginseer stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

ItItches.description:
<style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppresses</style> and <style="Displacement">pushes</style> an adjacent enemy unit and all enemy units adjacent to both the target and the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Parasite of Mortrex</style> one hex backwards. Enemy <style="Steppable">steppables</style> on affected hexes are destroyed. Then summons a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Tyranids">Ripper Swarm</style></style> in each hex vacated by this ability. The <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Tyranids">Ripper Swarms</style></style> can immediately attack. The <style="Faction_Tyranids">Parasite of Mortrex</style> may move again after activating this ability.

Ripper Swarm stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

ItsGonnaBlow.description:
If this unit is <style="Overkill">Overkilled</style> the ammo box explodes, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage</style> to all adjacent hexes.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

JakhalStimms.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to an adjacent enemy and all other enemies adjacent to both Macer and the target. Then Macer loses {[hpPct]}% of his current Health. Using Jakhal Stimms does not end Macer's turn.

KillMaimBurn.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy. Then performs a second attack targeting an adjacent enemy, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Eviscerate">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Eviscerating Damage</style>. Then performs a third attack targeting an enemy within range {[range]}, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_3]}x</style> <style="DMG_Plasma">{[minDmg_3]}-{[maxDmg_3]} Plasma Damage</style>. All attacks prioritise the same target until it is killed and then prioritise kills.

KissOfDeath.description: The <style="Faction_Aeldari">Harlequin Player</style> disappears and deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Direct">{[dmg]} Direct Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy, and up to {[maxAdjacentTargets]} additional enemies adjacent to a previous target, then it reappears in a hex adjacent to the last target hit.

KustomForceFieldReworked.description: All friendly adjacent units have <style="Stat_Armor">+{[extraArmor]} Armour</style>. <style="Faction_Orks">Gibbascrapz</style> and other friendly adjacent <style="Faction_Orks">Orks</style> have <style="Stat_Armor">+{[extraArmor_2]} Armour</style> instead and ignore <style="Battle_Fatigue">Battle Fatigue</style>, if they have it.

LeadingTheCharge.description:
If <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Dreir</style> has not moved, he gains <style="Buff_Infiltrate">Infiltrate</style> until the end of this turn and <style="Charging">charges</style> an enemy target that has a free adjacent hex within movement range {[range]}, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Power">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage</style> to it. Then, summons up to <style="Stat">{[nrOfSummons]}</style> <style="Summon"><style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Death Riders</style></style> in free adjacent hexes that can immediately attack enemies in range. All attacks triggered by this ability have <style="Piercing_Ratio">+{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio</style> for each friendly unit that has been defeated this battle. 

Death Rider stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

LightImUp.description: After performing a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style>, <style="Faction_Orks">Boss Gulgortz</style> performs a second attack against the same enemy, dealing <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Projectile">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage</style>. If the target is defeated, leftover hits are allocated to any random enemy target within {[range]} hexes.

LightOfSanguinius.description: If <style="Faction_BloodAngels">Dante</style> has not moved, he gains <style="Buff_Infiltrate">Infiltrate</style> until the end of this turn, then <style="Charging">charges</style> an enemy target that has a free adjacent hex within movement range {[range]} and deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Melta">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Melta Damage</style> to it. The target and enemy units surrounding it deal <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage</style> for {[nrOfRounds]} round. This effect is doubled if they attack friendly units that are at or below <style="Stat_Health">{[healthPct]}% Health</style>.

LionHelm.description: Friendly units within {[range]} hexes block an additional <style="Stat_Damage">{[blockDmg]} Damage</style> when they <style="Stat_Block">Block</style> and deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> with attacks triggered by <style="Overwatch">Overwatch</style>. Other friendly <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Dark Angels</style> within {[range]} hexes also have their <style="Stat_Block">Block</style> <style="Stat_Chance">chance</style> increased by <style="Stat">+{[blockChance]}%</style>

LivingLightning.description:
After moving, deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Direct">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage</style> to a random enemy within range 2.
If <style="Faction_Necrons">Thutmose</style> does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of his turn.

Loki_SwoopingHawk.description:
Flies over and deals a wave of damage from an initial melee target to targets up to 2 hexes behind. <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[dmg[0]]} Piercing Damage</style> to first target, <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[dmg[1]]} Piercing Damage</style> to the second, and <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[dmg[2]]} Piercing Damage</style> to the third. Lands in the hex directly behind the last target hit, or - in case that hex is occupied - to the closest free hex to it.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

LordOfTempests.description: <style="Faction_SpaceWolves">Njal</style>'s <style="NormalAttack">normal attacks</style> deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> for each hex surrounding him that is covered in <style="Effect_Ice">Ice</style>. The hex of each enemy that is hit by <style="Faction_SpaceWolves">Njal</style>'s normal attacks is covered in <style="Effect_Ice">Ice</style> at the end of the attack.

LordOfTheHost.description: Other friendly units within {[range]} hexes with <style="RapidAssault">Rapid Assault</style> or <style="Flying">Flying</style> deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> with melee attacks. Affected units that are at or below <style="Stat_Health">{[healthPct]}% Health</style> also score an additional <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style> with melee attacks.

MV71SniperDroneSquad.description:
Instead of a ranged attack, <style="Faction_Tau">Sho'syl</style> summons a <style="Summon">MV71 Sniper Drone</style> and commands it to attack the target. This attack uses <style="Faction_Tau">Sho'syl's</style> <style="Stat_Damage">Damage stat</style>, while other effects, like buffs, are taken from the Drone. If <style="Faction_Tau">Sho'syl</style> already controls {[maxSummons]} <style="Summon">MV71 Sniper Drones</style>, the one with the lowest <style="Stat_Health">Health</style> is removed before the new Drone is summoned.
The target also gains a <style="Debuff_Markerlight">Markerlight</style> until the end of <style="Faction_Tau">Sho'syl's</style> next turn.

MV71 Sniper Drones' stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

MartialExemplar.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style={[DamageProfileTypeStyle]}>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} {[DamageProfileType]}</style> to all adjacent enemies. Then moves up to {[nrOfTiles]} hex towards the closest enemy unit and performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style>. These attacks and all further attacks this turn have <style="Stat">+{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance</style> against <style="Summon">Summons</style>.

MartialSuperiority.description: If <style="Faction_BlackTemplars">Brother Jaeger</style> gets targeted with a melee attack from an adjacent enemy during the enemy’s turn, he deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Power">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage</style> to the attacker before the enemy attack executes.

MasterAnnihilator.description: When Vitruvius performs a normal attack against an enemy, that enemy is affected by Master Annihilator until Vitruvius is defeated or performs a normal attack against a different unit. Attacks by any friendly unit against the affected enemy score an additional hit, except attacks that deal Psychic Damage. This additional hit can deal a maximum of {[maxDmg]} Damage.

MasterOfTheTutelaries.description:
Summon a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_ThousandSons">Pink Horror</style></style> on a free hex adjacent to <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Abraxas</style>. Until the end of this turn, whenever an enemy unit is dealt <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style>, summon a <style="Summon2"><style="Faction_ThousandSons">Screamer of Tzeentch</style></style> on a free hex adjacent to <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Abraxas</style>, preferring hexes adjacent to enemy units. Newly summoned units can immediately attack an enemy in range but cannot move.

Pink Horror stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>

Screamer of Tzeentch stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp_2]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg_2]} Damage</style>

Maugetar.description: During his turn, if <style="Faction_Aeldari">Maugan Ra</style> has not moved, he can move after attacking and his attacks that contain a <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crit</style> deal an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Direct">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage</style>. When <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatching</style>, <style="Stat_CritDamage">Crits</style> deal this additional <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style> if he has not moved in his last turn.

MedicusMinistorum.description: Any friendly adjacent non-mechanical unit that takes <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> <style="Regenerate">regenerates</style> <style="Stat_Health">{[hpToHeal]} Health</style> afterwards, unless it is defeated.

MightFromBelow.description:
Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> to an adjacent enemy, then summons a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_Genestealers">Purestrain Genestealer</style></style> on each <style="Decoy">decoy</style> adjacent to <style="Faction_Genestealers">the Patermine</style>. The Purestrain Genestealers can immediately attack in <style="Stat_Melee">melee</style>, but cannot move this turn.

Purestrain Genestealer stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
<style="Stat_Armor">{[summonArmor]} Armour</style>

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

MindControl.description: Targets an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes that is adjacent to one or more friendly units. For this round and the next, that enemy unit deals <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReduction]} Damage</style>, takes <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style>, and becomes <style="Debuff_Taunted">Taunted</style> by the adjacent unit with the highest current <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>.

MischiefMakers.description: Targets of the <style="Faction_DeathGuard">Nurglings'</style> <style="NormalAttack">normal attacks</style> cannot be revived, <style="Healing">healed</style>, <style="Repairing">repaired</style>, or otherwise restore {[S/Health]} for {[nrOfRounds]} round. These attacks additionally have a <style="Stat_Chance">{[chance]}% chance</style> to <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppress</style> the target for {[nrOfRounds]} round.

MortarionsPlagueWind.description:
Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage</style> to a target within {[range]} hexes. Any enemies adjacent to the initial target take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Psychic Damage</style>. Any further enemies adjacent to at least one secondary target take <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Psychic">{[minDmg_3]}-{[maxDmg_3]} Psychic Damage</style>. <style="Summon">Summons</style> take double damage.

{[S/AbilityDamageExplanation]}

MortisRound.description:
Deals <style="Stat_Hits">1x</style> <style="DMG_Heavy">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage</style> to a single target within range 3, which is then <style="Displacement">pushed</style> back 1 hex.
The <style="Heavy_Weapon">Heavy Weapon</style> trait applies double to this ability.

MultiMelta.description:
Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style={[DamageProfileTypeStyle]}>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} {[DamageProfileType]}</style> to an enemy in range {[range]}. This attack deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> if the target is in a surrounding hex. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a <style="Cooldown">cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} rounds</style>.

<style="Cooldown">Initial cooldown: {[initialCooldownTurns]} round</style>.

MultiThreatEliminator.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">6x</style> <style="DMG_Gauss">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Molecular Damage</style> to an enemy within range {[range]}. Any leftover <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> are allocated to another enemy adjacent to the target and in range {[range]}. Each enemy killed adds <style="Stat_Hits">+{[extraHit]} hit</style> and the ability keeps targeting new enemies until there are no more enemies or <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> left.

MultiTracker.description: All enemy units that did not move during their turn receive a <style="Debuff_Markerlight">Markerlight</style>.

MurderousSwing.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Piercing">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage</style> to all adjacent enemies. If this attack only hits one enemy, it deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style>.

MyWillBeDoneOverlord.description: At the end of <style="Faction_Necrons">Anuphet's</style> turn, a friendly adjacent <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> unit performs a <style="NormalAttack">normal attack</style> against a target in range, using <style="Stat">{[dmgPct]}%</style> of its own <style="Stat_Damage">Damage stat</style> to a maximum of <style="Stat_Damage">{[maxDmg]} Damage</style>. If no attack was performed this way, Anuphet gains <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> until the end of his next turn.

Narthecium.description: When an adjacent friendly non-<style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> unit is defeated, it is immediately revived with a maximum of <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style>, unless <style="Overkill">Overkilled</style>. Can only be triggered once per turn.

Neuroparasite.description:
Each enemy that is dealt <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style> by the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Neurothrope</style> is infected by a <style="Debuff_Neuroparasite">Neuroparasite</style> until either the unit is healed or the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Neurothrope</style> is defeated. Whenever a unit infected with a <style="Debuff_Neuroparasite">Neuroparasite</style> takes <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style> or becomes affected by an attack or ability that would <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppress</style> it, the level of the <style="Debuff_Neuroparasite">Neuroparasite</style> increases by 1, up to a maximum of <style="STAT">{[buffMaxLevel]}</style>.

<style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style> dealt by the <style="Faction_Tyranids">Neurothrope</style> is increased by <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> for each level of a <style="Debuff_Neuroparasite">Neuroparasite</style> on the target.

Nightshroud.description: All friendly units starting their turn adjacent to <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Sibyll Devine</style> gain <style="Buff_Infiltrate">Infiltrate</style> for that turn and take <style="Stat_Damage">-{[dmgReduction]} Damage</style> from each hit in their and the next enemy turn.

NoHidingFromTheWatchers.description: Any <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> this unit takes is reduced to 0. After being attacked, this unit moves {[nrOfTiles]} hex, trying to move away from all other units. If there is no other friendly <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Dark Angel</style> on the battlefield except other <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Watchers in the Dark</style>, then this unit leaves the battlefield.

NovaBoost.description: Marks all hexes adjacent to the <style="Faction_Tau">Riptide</style>. <style="Tile_Trench">Trenches</style> cannot be marked. At the beginning of its next turn, the Riptide deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Particle">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Particle Damage</style> to each enemy on marked hexes and then flies to a new location on the battlefield.

NovaCharge.description: Faces in one of 6 directions and marks all hexes in a 3-tile wide line, originating from the <style="Faction_Tau">Riptide</style> and additionally marks {[nrOfTargets]} hexes that are not on this line. <style="Tile_Trench">Trenches</style> cannot be marked. At the beginning of the Riptide's next turn, it deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Particle">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Particle Damage</style> to all enemies on the hexes marked by the line, and <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits_2]}x</style> <style="DMG_Blast">{[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Blast Damage</style> to all enemies on the other marked hexes.
